from datetime import datetime

RESPONSES_DIR = "/root/gated_mfrm_judge_bias/data/arena_hard/responses"

    ("llama-3.3-70b",   "http://localhost:8001/v1", "llama-3.3-70b-instruct", 0.0),
    ("qwen2.5-72b",     "http://localhost:8002/v1", "qwen2.5-72b-instruct",   0.0),
    ("mistral-large-2", "http://localhost:8003/v1", "mistral-large-instruct",  0.0),
]

MAX_TOKENS = 2048


def load_prompts():
    with open(PROMPTS_PATH) as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f]


def load_existing(model_name):
    path = os.path.join(RESPONSES_DIR, f"{model_name}.jsonl")
    existing = set()
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path) as f:
            for line in f:
                try:
                    existing.add(json.loads(line)["id"])
                except (json.JSONDecodeError, KeyError):
                    pass
    return existing


def generate_for_endpoint(target_name, base_url, served_model, temperature, prompts, workers=8):
    os.makedirs(RESPONSES_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    out_path = os.path.join(RESPONSES_DIR, f"{target_name}.jsonl")
    existing = load_existing(target_name)
    todo = [p for p in prompts if p["id"] not in existing]

    print(f"[{target_name}] total={len(prompts)}, existing={len(existing)}, "
          f"todo={len(todo)}, workers={workers}")

    if not todo:
        print(f"  Already complete.")
        return len(existing), 0

    client = OpenAI(api_key=[REDACTED]"dummy", base_url=base_url)
    success = [0]
    errors = [0]
    start = time.time()
    write_lock = threading.Lock()
    counter = [0]

    def _gen_one(p):
        for attempt in range(4):
            try:
                kwargs = dict(
                    model=served_model,
                    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": p["prompt"]}],
                    max_tokens=MAX_TOKENS,
                )
                if temperature is not None:
                    kwargs["temperature"] = temperature
                resp = client.chat.completions.create(**kwargs)
                text = resp.choices[0].message.content or ""
                break
            except Exception as e:
                if attempt == 3:
                    text = f"ERROR: {e}"
                else:
                    time.sleep(2 ** attempt)

        with write_lock:
            with open(out_path, "a") as fout:
                fout.write(json.dumps({"id": p["id"], "response": text},
                                      ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
            if text.startswith("ERROR:"):
                errors[0] += 1
            else:
                success[0] += 1
            counter[0] += 1
            if counter[0] % 20 == 0:
                elapsed = time.time() - start
                rate = counter[0] / elapsed
                eta = (len(todo) - counter[0]) / rate if rate > 0 else 0
                print(f"  [{target_name}] {counter[0]}/{len(todo)} "
                      f"({rate:.2f}/s, ETA {eta/60:.1f}min)")

    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        list(pool.map(_gen_one, todo))

    elapsed = time.time() - start
    print(f"  [{target_name}] Done: {success} ok, {errors} err, "
          f"{elapsed/60:.1f}min")
    return len(existing) + success, errors


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--model", type=str, default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, default=8,
                        help="Concurrent workers per endpoint (default: 8)")
    parser.add_argument("--all", action="store_true")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    prompts = load_prompts()
    print(f"Loaded {len(prompts)} prompts @ {datetime.now().isoformat()}")

    if args.model:
        selected = [e for e in ENDPOINTS if e[0] == args.model]
    elif args.all:
        selected = ENDPOINTS
    else:
        print("Specify --model or --all")
        return

    # Run all endpoints in parallel
    results = {}
    with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=len(selected)) as pool:
        futures = {}
        for name, url, model, temp in selected:
            f = pool.submit(generate_for_endpoint, name, url, model, temp, prompts, args.workers)

        for f in concurrent.futures.as_completed(futures):
            name = futures[f]
            try:
                results[name] = f.result()
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  [{name}] EXCEPTION: {e}")
                results[name] = (0, -1)

    print(f"\n{'='*40}")
    print(f"SUMMARY @ {datetime.now().isoformat()}")
    for name, (done, err) in results.items():
        print(f"  {name:<25} {done}/500 (err={err})")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
